resource_load.note: N+1 pattern: loads task, steps, runner per job

performance_issues.description: For each job, ToActionWorkflowJob loads task by ID, then loads task steps, then loads runner by ID - all individually per job
performance_issues.impact: 3 extra queries per job; with 50 jobs per page = 150 extra queries
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load tasks, steps, and runners for all jobs in a single query

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch load tasks and runners for all jobs instead of per-job queries
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce queries from O(3n) to O(3) for n jobs
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Pre-load all tasks by job IDs, then batch load runners by runner IDs

resource_load.note: Loads latest attempt per run individually

performance_issues.description: ToActionWorkflowRun calls run.GetLatestAttempt(ctx) individually for each run in the list
performance_issues.impact: 1 extra query per run; with 50 runs per page = 50 extra queries
performance_issues.recommendation: Batch load latest attempts for all runs

optimization_recommendations.description: Batch load latest attempts for all runs in a single query using run.LatestAttemptID
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from O(n) to O(1) queries for attempts
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Collect all LatestAttemptIDs and batch fetch from action_run_attempt

resource_load.note: LoadAttributes loads job->run->repo chain per task

performance_issues.description: ToActionTask calls LoadJob then LoadRun then LoadRepo individually per task
performance_issues.impact: 3 extra queries per task; with 50 tasks = 150 extra queries
performance_issues.recommendation: TaskList.LoadAttributes should batch load all jobs, runs, repos

optimization_recommendations.description: Use TaskList.LoadAttributes batch loading instead of per-task loading
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Reduce from O(3n) to O(3) queries
optimization_recommendations.implementation: The code already calls taskList.LoadAttributes which should batch - verify it does

resource_load.note: Reads git tree and workflow file contents

performance_issues.description: For each workflow entry, GetContentFromEntry reads blob content to parse workflow name - this is a git I/O operation per file
performance_issues.impact: With many workflow files, sequential git blob reads can be slow
performance_issues.recommendation: Consider caching workflow metadata or reading content lazily

optimization_recommendations.description: Cache workflow metadata (name, state) keyed by commit SHA + workflow path
optimization_recommendations.estimated_impact: Avoid repeated git blob reads for unchanged workflows
optimization_recommendations.implementation: Use in-memory or Redis cache with commit SHA as cache key
